subject: How to play with the prior of hyperpar in ar1 model

messages.author: 9d5350458e6c3801
messages.subject: How to play with the prior of hyperpar in ar1 model
parts:
Dear help,
 
I am fitting some time series with ar1 model using inla. I wanna play with the hyperparameters using different priors. I have already looked at the documentation for ar1 model, and found that internally the hyperparameters are 
theta1 = log(kappa), where kappa = tau(1-rho^2), theta2 = log((1+rho)/(1-rho))
I should be able to change the prior using hyper=list(...) in the f(...,model="ar1", hyper=...). 
What I am confused is that if I can change the expressions of theta1 and theta2 since there are options "to.theta", "from.theta" in the hyper specification. If I can, how can inla know what is the likelihood relating to the new-defined theta1 and theta2?

Thanks a lot!
 
Cheers,
Erik

the transformation done in the inla-program. so you're stucked with
these transformations, sorry. I agree, this is a design error...
